distributed_contract.thread_multiplication: full plan is sent to every selected worker
distributed_contract.worker_identity_source: worker-local.txt staged independently on each worker

global_property.assertion: not part of basic-r/basic-R; see expected/global-properties.json

callback_invocation_ordinal.advances: one per invocation, including ProcessBatch and lifecycle callbacks

delivered_event_ordinal.advances: one per SampleStarted/SampleOccurred/SampleStopped event item; ProcessBatch advances by event_count

HostArgument.host_presence: absent, null, or present-empty only when the pinned Java call can supply it

lifecycle_overload.host_policy: record the pinned Java overload and do not fill a missing host from worker identity

process_batch_delivery.delivery_kind: ProcessBatch first-class callback; not synthetic repeated SampleOccurred
process_batch_delivery.ordinal_relationship: callback invocation state advances by one; delivered-event state advances by event_count

event_ack.ack_unit: validated router-admitted delivered events, never only a transport frame

terminal_success.accounting: delivered_events = accepted_events = acknowledged_events and delivered_bytes = accepted_bytes = acknowledged_bytes; TestEnded and SenderDrainProof identities match the same lifecycle generation

result_field_policy.timing: see normalization.timing_tolerances; no static runtime value is supplied
result_field_policy.byte_fields: retained and compared when a pinned run exists; never normalized away

generated_from.oracle_execution: not run; this is a partial contract projection
generated_from.raw_artifacts: none; no oracle output is committed

timestamp.allowed_variance: wall-clock value is recorded by a future run but not asserted by this static projection

normalization.reason: Basic remote selection is represented as a static contract. Runtime event multiplicity, timing, and result values require an external Java/RMI execution and are not fabricated here.
